patch.sql:
select
    o_orderkey as order_key,
    o_custkey as customer_key,
    o_orderstatus as order_status,
    o_totalprice as total_price,
    o_orderdate as order_date,
    o_orderpriority as priority,
    _loaded_at as loaded_at
from {{ source('raw', 'orders') }}
patch.explanation: The not_null test on stg_orders.order_date failed with 363 null rows. In the current model, order_date is set to NULL for rows where o_orderstatus = 'P' (case when o_orderstatus <> 'P' then o_orderdate end). The source raw.orders always has a non-null o_orderdate, and the test expects order_date never null. Changing the column to directly use o_orderdate removes the conditional nulling and satisfies the not_null test.

    o_orderkey as order_key,
    o_custkey as customer_key,

    o_totalprice as total_price,
    case when o_orderstatus <> 'P' then o_orderdate end as order_date,
    o_orderpriority as priority,
    _loaded_at as loaded_at
from {{ source('raw', 'orders') }}

args.query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_rows, COUNT(order_date) AS not_null_rows, COUNT(*)-COUNT(order_date) AS null_rows FROM raw.orders
